Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “First time in Harlem, the best food hands down”; “the drinks were great”. Restaurantji guests also say the drinks were great, and one diner bought her seasoning and hot sauce to take home.

itineraryNote: Sylvia's Harlem: the Queen of Soul Food's 1962 Harlem landmark; go for Sunday gospel brunch and bring home the hot sauce.
review1: Sylvia's delivers classic soul food that first-time Harlem visitors describe as outstanding, often clearing their plates. Several separate reviews echo this point.
review2: Diners consistently praise both food and service, describing a warm, welcoming dining room. It comes up often enough to plan around.
review3: Drinks hold up as well, with guests describing very tasty meals paired with good cocktails. This pattern shows up across many of the saved reviews.
review4: The house seasoning and hot sauce are sold on site and make an easy edible souvenir to take home. It is a consistent thread in recent feedback.
